theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_face_replacement
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : NNReal, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal), IsCompact K → ∃ 𝒬₀ : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬₀.Finite ∧ ∀ Q₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q₀ → Q₀.support ⊆ K → Q₀.support ⊆ {x : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z} → Q₀.mass ≤ Λ → Q₀.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ Pc ∈ 𝒬₀, IsIntegerMultiplicity Pc ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Pc.boundary ∧ (Pc = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ Pc.mass) ∧ Pc.mass ≤ c * Q₀.mass ∧ Pc.boundary.mass ≤ c * Q₀.boundary.mass ∧ (Q₀ - Pc).mass ≤ c * Q₀.boundary.mass ∧ Pc.support ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt P) Q₀.support ∧ (Q₀ - Pc).support ∪ Pc.boundary.support ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt P) Q₀.boundary.support
